#!/usr/bin/env bash
src="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions"
dst="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/workspace/sessions"
mkdir -p "$dst"
synced=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  rel="${file#$src/}"
  srcfile="$file"
  dstfile="$dst/$rel"
  if [ ! -f "$dstfile" ] || ! cmp -s "$srcfile" "$dstfile"; then

    synced+=("$rel")

  git add "sessions/*.jsonl"
  msg="Sync sessions $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")"
  git commit -m "$msg"
  git push
  echo "Synced files:"
  for f in "${synced[@]}"; do echo "$f"; done
else
